name: Byzantine Reconquest of North Africa
summary: General Belisarius defeats the Vandal king Gelimer at the Battles of Ad Decimum and Tricamarum with a force of only 15,000, destroying the Vandal kingdom in less than a year. The campaign recovers the western Mediterranean's grain supply for Byzantium and re-establishes imperial control over North Africa for a century.

_quarry.structural_significance: First step in Justinian's reconquest program; demonstrates Byzantine military capacity against western kingdoms; but exposes the overextension that will strain Byzantine finances for decades.
